show.description: When a fierce young wrestler enters a deadly underground fight to save her ailing mother, betrayal shatters her world and a mistaken encounter with a superstar ignites an unexpected bond. As she becomes his bodyguard and uncovers her stolen identity, love, danger, and deception collide—forcing her to choose between her past and the war for her future.
